connector.name: Snapforge
connector.registryDescription: Screenshots, PDFs and Markdown from any URL or HTML for AI agents, via the SnapForge API
connector.summary: Hosted at snapforge.org over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package snapforge-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace org.snapforge, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SNAPFORGE_API_KEY
env.description: SnapForge API key. Optional: without it, call the snapforge_signup tool once to get a free key (100 renders/month)
